dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Forty minutes with a tidepool specialist. That's the invitation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Does the invitation say how much of that time is actually at the water?

dialogueInline.speaker: Dr. Dorothea “Dora” Kwon
dialogueInline.text: Twelve minutes at the wet edge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: The animals get their quiet after that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Our first guest waited six months. I hope the rest is worth the wait.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: I'd rather show her than explain it.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Dora
dialogueInline.text: Hands low, nothing comes out of the water. Watch what happens if you stay still.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian
dialogueInline.text: That little one's been working its way across the rock all this time?

dialogueInline.speaker: Sal
dialogueInline.text: Longer than you've been here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur
dialogueInline.text: That light is perfect. We hardly need to add anything.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: You'll find they like that.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: I booked this six months ago. Does it ever look the same twice?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: It looked different when I walked through here at breakfast.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia
dialogueInline.text: A school group just arrived. Thirty-two pairs of curious eyes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: They picked a good day.

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: Is there a bad one?

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: Before I make this annoying: can I use that corner?

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: No.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: Great. Where can I go?

dialogueInline.speaker: Salvatore “Sal” Delgado
dialogueInline.text: Three meters left.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: Same water, better light. And Sal's carts stay out of your shot.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: Three meters is cheap.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: Why does that one keep turning into the current?

dialogueInline.speaker: Dora
dialogueInline.text: Watch what happens when the water shifts.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: We're nearly at the edge of the visit.

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: I can stop asking.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dora
dialogueInline.text: Please don't. Come around the dry side and I'll show you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: I'll clear the wet edge for the next group.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: The tidepool's between visits. Would you care for something to drink?

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: They paid to see the habitat, not admire the furniture.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia
dialogueInline.text: They've already admired all of it. Twice.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: They're not angry. They're bored. That's worse for an aquarium.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: Then give them something worth looking at.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian
dialogueInline.text: I was going to offer them a backstage look.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: Dora's still with a guest back there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: They came for the tidepool. They've seen enough of the lounge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian
dialogueInline.text: What haven't they seen?

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya
dialogueInline.text: There's a water sample in the microscope salon.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian
dialogueInline.text: All this trouble, and the best thing might fit on a slide.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Our first guest keeps looking through the door at the water.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: She paid for time with someone who knows the tidepool.

dialogueInline.speaker: Elliot Richards
dialogueInline.text: The invitation does say that.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: This sample came from the tidepool.

dialogueInline.speaker: Julian Heatherington
dialogueInline.text: You should see what's moving in here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: I'll ask whether she wants to.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: There's something from that pool under the microscope. Want to see?

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: Can I come back to the water afterward?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: You can look as long as you like.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: You may have to pry her away.

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: You can try.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: Give them the whole wall. The water can carry this.

dialogueInline.speaker: Staff Educator
dialogueInline.text: This came from what you were watching a minute ago.

dialogueInline.speaker: Staff Educator
dialogueInline.text: This water came from the pool you were leaning over.

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: All of that was in there?

dialogueInline.speaker: Staff Educator
dialogueInline.text: And none of it is posing for us.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: Leave the whole wall open. It looks incredible.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: I think we lost her.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: She's exactly where she wants to be.

dialogueSource: Azure Reach Issue 3 editorial C: panel balloon order and voice pass

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: I swear I'm not asking for a dolphin selfie.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dr. Dorothea “Dora” Kwon
dialogueInline.text: That does help.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: You've paid for a photograph of the ceiling lights.

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: Can it look like what I actually saw?

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: No flash by the habitat.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: I wouldn't do that to the water.

dialogueInline.text: This is the angle I wanted.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: I'm not asking anybody to stand under it.

dialogueInline.speaker: VIP Guest
dialogueInline.text: That's the water I wanted to remember.

dialogueInline.speaker: Maya Serrano
dialogueInline.text: Better than a ceiling-light selfie.

dialogueInline.text: I thought premium guests would get closer.

dialogueInline.text: The animals don't know what anyone paid.

dialogueInline.text: Look at her. She's taken more pictures of that rock than of the entire park.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur
dialogueInline.text: And she remembers exactly where the tiny one was hiding.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice
dialogueInline.text: She's been here longer than we expected.

dialogueInline.text: Use that photo on the invitation. I want to come here.

dialogueInline.text: It's open. You can come around this side.

dialogueInline.text: My kid thinks we need special tickets now.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip
dialogueInline.text: He couldn't see the open path from there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: The guests paid for something private. If the rope goes, what stays?

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip O'Mally
dialogueInline.text: Their expert. That family just wants to see the water.

dialogueInline.speaker: Nia Patel
dialogueInline.text: Their son thinks the tidepool was taken away.

dialogueInline.speaker: Fleur Fontaine
dialogueInline.text: I never liked this rope.

dialogueInline.speaker: Beatrice Halstead
dialogueInline.text: Keep the host where guests can see them. Take it down.

dialogueInline.text: It never closed. Come see.

dialogueInline.text: There it is. Under the rock, beside the edge.

dialogueInline.text: Where? I can't see it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pip

dialogueInline.text: There it goes across the stone.

dialogueInline.text: There's a habitat-support fund. The whole place benefits.

dialogueInline.text: The fund supports the whole habitat.

dialogueInline.text: That's fine. I just know where to find my favorite.

dialogueInline.speaker: Dr. Dorothea “Dora” Kwon
dialogueInline.text: That's the end of our wet-edge time. Thank you, everyone.

dialogueInline.text: Is the microscope still showing the water?

dialogueInline.text: I can see why.

dialogueInline.text: How long does it stay there?
